members.name: tvg_gradient_set_color_stops
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_gradient_set_color_stops(Tvg_Gradient grad, const Tvg_Color_Stop* color_stop, uint32_t cnt)
members.brief: Sets the parameters of the colors of the gradient and their position.

params.name: grad
params.description: The Tvg_Gradient object of which the color information is to be set.

params.name: color_stop
params.description: An array of Tvg_Color_Stop data structure.

params.name: cnt
params.description: The size of the `color_stop` array equal to the colors number used in the gradient.

members.name: tvg_gradient_get_color_stops
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_gradient_get_color_stops(const Tvg_Gradient grad, const Tvg_Color_Stop** color_stop, uint32_t* cnt)
members.brief: Gets the parameters of the colors of the gradient, their position and number
description: The function does not allocate any memory.

params.name: grad
params.description: The Tvg_Gradient object of which to get the color information.

params.name: color_stop
params.description: An array of Tvg_Color_Stop data structure.

params.name: cnt
params.description: The size of the `color_stop` array equal to the colors number used in the gradient.

members.name: tvg_gradient_set_spread
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_gradient_set_spread(Tvg_Gradient grad, const Tvg_Stroke_Fill spread)
members.brief: Sets the Tvg_Stroke_Fill value, which specifies how to fill the area outside the gradient bounds.

members.name: tvg_gradient_get_spread
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_gradient_get_spread(const Tvg_Gradient grad, Tvg_Stroke_Fill* spread)
members.brief: Gets the FillSpread value of the gradient object.

members.name: tvg_gradient_set_transform
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_gradient_set_transform(Tvg_Gradient grad, const Tvg_Matrix* m)
members.brief: Sets the matrix of the affine transformation for the gradient object.
description: The augmented matrix of the transformation is expected to be given.

params.name: grad
params.description: The Tvg_Gradient object to be transformed.

members.name: tvg_gradient_get_transform
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_gradient_get_transform(const Tvg_Gradient grad, Tvg_Matrix* m)
members.brief: Gets the matrix of the affine transformation of the gradient object.
description: In case no transformation was applied, the identity matrix is set.

params.name: grad
params.description: The Tvg_Gradient object of which to get the transformation matrix.

members.name: tvg_gradient_get_type
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_gradient_get_type(const Tvg_Gradient grad, Tvg_Type* type)
members.brief: Gets the unique value of the gradient instance indicating the instance type.

params.name: grad
params.description: The Tvg_Gradient object of which to get the type value.

params.name: type
params.description: The unique type of the gradient instance type.

members.name: tvg_gradient_duplicate
description: Creates a new object and sets its all properties as in the original object.

params.name: grad
params.description: The Tvg_Gradient object to be copied.

members.returns: A copied Tvg_Gradient object if succeed, `nullptr` otherwise.

params.name: grad
params.description: The gradient object to be deleted.
